steps.name: Strange Machine
steps.text: Zumama, boat assembly: correct?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: It looks structurally sound, but there are a few things we can tweak. For example—

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: There, that should make it more solid.

steps.name: Strange Machine
steps.text: Zumama, Zumama: amazing.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Just the product of experience.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: There you are, Zumama.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Inam? What are you doing here?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: This survey equipment has to get across, right? I came to help since I didn't have anything else to do.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Why are you thanking me? Looks like you're actually becoming one of these robots.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Yes, I'm glad to make so many new friends.

steps.name: Strange Machine
steps.text: Zumama, Zumama: friend!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: And I've been trying to find a date for Lancet-2.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Lancet-2 is the robot that came with Rhodes Island, right?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Yes, she's my big sister now.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I'm not skilled enough to make a robot as smart as Lancet-2, so I'm trying to find one in this group.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: And...?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: They're very nice, but not really her type.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: She likes intellectuals, like the Doctor. It's a bit of a headache.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Never mind, you're not the only weirdo in Tiacauh.

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: Hey everybody, this is Croque, and I've found a safer vantage point to continue the broadcast from.

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: How far until goal? 300m? Ah, forget it.

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: What's really important is that the architect Stitch Canvas, the only student of Master Finch, has found a boat and jumped into the race!

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: Oh? Looks like he's talking to us. Let's zoom in and see what he's saying...

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: 'I'm gonna win,' I think. Yup, I'm sure that's it.

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: And he just raised his middle finger to show his motivation. Looks like there's a fiery heart beneath this architect's cold surface!

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: He may have gotten a late start, but that vehicle is definitely a huge advantage.

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: He's closing the distance as we speak!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Things are pretty lively over there.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: I wanted to say that this is what happens with Gavial around, but she's not the only one who's let her hair down.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: You're not used to it?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: You have to get used to it, living in Acahualla.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: You get so used to it I feel weird if there's no one arguing and making noise around me.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: You're a proper Tiacauh now.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Of course I am.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Speaking of which, Zumama, if Gavial didn't come back the year before last, you were planning to become the Great Chief of Acahualla, weren't you?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Becoming Great Chief wasn't the real goal; it was a way for me to prove myself.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I wanted to build the most powerful machine ever.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: I knew I shouldn't have placed any expectations on you.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Are you thinking about being lord ameer?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Good to see that you and Tomimi have learned something about politics, unlike Gavial.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: I don't know how she's survived on the outside all these years.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Some things we deal with as a matter of course just don't factor in for Gavial. Like adapting to your environment.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Haha, that's true.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: So you want her to become lord ameer? Are you sure she's suitable?

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Pretty sure you could pick somebody off any street in Sargon and get a better lord ameer than her.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Agreed.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: But if we're choosing a Tiacauh to lead Acahualla, there's no one more suitable than her.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Are you speaking as a Tiacauh, or as a Sargon Messenger?

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: We're entering the final stretch of the race!

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: Gavial remains in first place, but her lead continues to shrink.

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: It's not Avdotya who's closing the distance, though!

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: Despite her valiant effort, her choice of clothing has become dead weight.

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: Literally, as the weight of her clothes is slowing her down!

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: Meanwhile, Elysium is rapidly closing in!

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: Conserving his strength in the first half, Elysium now shows off his true ability.

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: He has passed Avdotya and is almost neck-and-neck with Gavial!

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: However—

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: Neither of them are aware of the true threat approaching!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: I'm impressed with Elysium. I never thought he could catch up to Gavial.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: His attitude is a mask. You can't get complacent.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Yes, I noticed. He doesn't want people to know how good he is.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Don't change the subject.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Alright, looks like you've learned a thing or two at Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Not on purpose, but Master Closure makes me go to meetings about stuff besides technology, so I've heard a bunch of things.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Looks like she has high hopes for you.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: As for your question...

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: I've lived in Acahualla for a long time.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Compared to city life, I prefer to stay in the jungles, watching you people fight over stupid things.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Maybe it's hard to believe, but for me, I'm a Tiacauh a Sargon Messenger at the same time. I don't have to pick.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Or I guess I could say, my Sargon perspective tells me that Acahualla won't stay unexplored forever. That's why I hope you'll seize the opportunity.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I believe you.

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: We're headed towards a climax.

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: Exercising his explosive potential, Elysium has almost caught up to Gavial.

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: Avdotya's not out of this race yet, though, and she's still keeping pace with the two in front of her.

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: No need to push it, Avdotya!

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: But now all three of them have noticed the threat approaching from behind—Stitch, riding in his boat!

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: The wonders of machinery! He has caught up to the three in front of him in a very short period of time!

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: Only a hundred meters to the goal!

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: It's like we're at the starting line again. Three swimmers and a boat, racing their way into the final stretch!

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: But, Inam.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: I won't help you convince her.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Gavial should not sit in that chair.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: You'll get the same answer if you ask Tomimi.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: Figure it out for yourself. I'm busy.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: ...Fine.

steps.name: Eunectes
steps.text: If you have too much free time, you can help me build this boat while you think about it.

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: You really count every last coin, don't you?

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: Eighty meters!

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: Avdotya got caught in the boat's wake. She's coughing and she has to stop! Yes!

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: Er, I mean, what a shame.

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: Fifty meters!

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: Elysium tries to board the boat, but took an accidental hit from Master Edge, who is angry at Stitch, and falls back into the water!

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: There are bubbles coming to the surface. Is he okay?

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: Thirty meters!

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: Master Edge leaps from Gavial's back onto the Ale Keg, and hits Stitch on the head!

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: Ouch! That must have hurt!

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: By the way, Ale Keg is the name that I just gave to this boat, following in the footsteps of my other masterpiece, 'The Great Aquapit'!

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: Looks like the winner will be Ga—

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: Wait, not quite!

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: The fight between Master Edge and Stitch has destroyed the boat's instruments!

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: There's an ominous rumble coming from the Ale Keg!

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: She dashes ahead like an arrow!

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: Not even Gavial can catch the out-of-control boat!

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: The boat is the first to arrive at the goal!

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: The winner of this swimming contest is—

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: The Ale Keg!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: ...What?

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: Wait, it's not over yet!

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: The Ale Keg isn't satisfied with simply crossing the finish line!

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: She rushes ashore and charges toward the cave-in!
Boom!!!

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: Master Edge and Stitch are thrown from the boat!

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: The Ale Keg has put a huge hole in the rock blocking the tunnel exit!

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: Poor Ale Keg, never to taste the breakfast of champions!

steps.name: Announcement From Afar
steps.text: A moment of silence for her!

steps.name: Inam
steps.text: What on earth are these people doing?
